{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the classification of organism|the aquatic vessel known as an [[Amphibion]]}}
[[File:KitFisto-SWE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]] were an amphibious species]]
'''Amphibians''', also known as '''amphiboids''',<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref> were [[Species/Legends|species]] that could live both on land and [[Water/Legends|underwater]], or had two stages of life, one that was completely water-based, the other land-based. Some amphibious creatures were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] as gill-breathing [[Tadpole/Legends|tadpoles]] and evolved into [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]-breathing adults. Others had compound [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] allowing them to breathe underwater and on land.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]] were amphibians,<ref name="CSWE III 145">{{CSWECite|III|145|Shawda Ubb}}</ref> as were the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]] of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]],<ref name="WW">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref> the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Ootoolan]]s of [[Ootoola]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|415|Ootoola}}</ref>
